claim: All source cases are NEW JANUS-generated SAT examples, not externally provided, not hidden independent source; source-generator family features chosen before outcomes. This protocol tests an early RAW baseline response to CNF presentation variability.

calibration.derived_previous_E12B_n288_shuffle: Raw CMS native solve ~0.0248s vs E12B ~0.0242s; full original raw now almost same or faster, so source XOR coverage alone is not reliable to predict gain.
calibration.certificate: ALL 2^(w-1) unique literal-sign forbidden masks of exactly one parity on identical absolute variable support; exact source indices as proof; preserve all extras and unconverted CNF.
calibration.out_of_development_width3_4_6: COLLECT EXACT PROVEN SOURCE MASK METRICS AND ABSTAIN (RAW) FOR C1; unconditional variable-width native in separate frozen arm.
calibration.early_raw_if_verified_SAT: If raw probe returns verified full original CNF SAT within timeout, stop; otherwise after bounded timeout use eligible previously proven XOR. Always count raw probe, indexed analysis, process overhead and final solver in full cold wall.

science_gates.source_correctness: Full original SAT model before every comparison and every reported SAT result replayed on all original transformed clauses, pinned SHA
science_gates.index_proof: Zero source-unsound XOR, never remove original uncertified clause
science_gates.source_order: Zero candidate eligibility decision flips on equivalent original CNF shuffles
science_gates.negative_cost: If original source*variant median raw/candidate < 2/3, C1 net-cost gate fail; disclose all lighter slowdowns too
science_gates.positive: At least 1 new internally generated ORIGINAL source variant with median raw/candidate >=1.20 on four completed verified SAT pairs
science_gates.outperformance: Compare C1 to E12B on matched source/variant/VM; do not claim superior unless it demonstrably improves an E12B loss on new original SHA
science_gates.avoid_pseudoreplication: Group observations at original source and family, not 720 independent SAT sources
